description:
5% Niacinamide Body Wash for Women deep cleanses the skin, removes dry patches, strengthens your skin's moisture barrier and leaves you hydrated & refreshed with every use

▶Deep cleanses skin: This Niacinamide body wash deep cleanses pores by reducing sebum production and removing impurities

▶ Evens the skin:  Niacinamide and Aloe Vera help battle hyperpigmentation & skin discoloration, giving you radiant & glowing skin

▶ Provides intense hydration and nourishes the skin: Niacinamide is a natural humectant, i.e. it pulls moisture from the environment keeping skin soft and supple

▶ Leaves you refreshed with every wash:  With every use, the Aloe Vera in this niacinamide cleanser leaves you feeling refreshed and rejuvenated

Suitable for all skin types

Patch test is recommended

Use everyday after shower for the best results

faqs.question: Can I use niacinamide body wash every day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day.

faqs.question: Is niacinamide good for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types.

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: We recommend consulting an expert to verify the same.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with an expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

faqs.question: What does Niacinamide do for skin?
faqs.answer: Niacinamide helps repair the protective layer of the skin. It promotes the production of ceramides and elastin. Over time it helps reduce melanin transfer to outer layer of skin, which helps fade marks
